ALTER EGO - APPLE IIGS======================Alter Ego for the Apple IIgs, built on the silky-gs NES runtime.This disk boots straight into the game: GS/OS starts /SYSTEM/START,which is the game itself, so no Finder is needed.BOOTING-------Start the IIgs with this disk in a 3.5" drive, or mount it as s7d1in GSplus / GSPort.  A 16 MHz machine reaches the title in about20 seconds.  A stock 2.8 MHz IIgs boots in 2-3 minutes and plays atabout 30 fps.TITLE SCREEN------------  Up / Down, X / Z     Move through the menu lines  Left / Right         Change START LEVEL (0 = the hidden Cow Level)  Return or P          Start the game  Tab                  Open / close the sound testSOUND TEST (Tab on the title screen)------------------------------------  Left / Right         Choose the SFX or BGM field  Up / Down            Change the value  Space                Audition the selected effect or song  Z                    Stop the music  Tab                  Back to the titleIN GAME-------  Arrow keys           Move / climb  Z or Space           NES A button  X                    NES B button  Return or P          Start; pause (RESUME / RESTART / EXIT GAME)  Tab                  NES Select  ?  (Shift-/)         silky-gs options: AUDIO, VIDEO, INPUT,                       DRIVERS, CREDITSNOTES-----  * X and Z work with Caps Lock on or off.  * This 800 KiB disk has no Finder: the game comes up by itself.    Q (then Y) ends the game for good: the screen says so, and    only the reset button starts the machine again.  EXIT GAME in    the pause menu still returns to the title screen.  * On a full System 6 disk Q (then Y) quits to the Finder instead.  * Settings made with ? (audio quality, keyboard driver, ...) are    saved in a .prefs file next to the game when you quit, and loaded    again the next time the game starts.
